Checked without one-off cash: deal payments are booked under investing, so free cash flow never carried them, and no settlement or transition tax is stated for the window, so the charge stands. Restated to the amortisation floor: the filed cost lines leave a 41.40% pre-tax margin where the cash over 2023 to 2025 supports 50.32%, so the charge rebuilds at -8.92%. It was held at nil, but NVO books 6,529mm DKK of non-cash amortisation of acquired intangibles inside its cost lines in FY2025 (0000353278-26-000012), 2.11% of revenue, so the charge stops at that floor: -2.11%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 NVO's cash flow statement shows receivables up 20,296mm DKK, inventories up 25,235mm DKK, payables up 15,158mm DKK, a working capital build of 30,373mm DKK, 3.65% of revenue.
